An injective extension-by-zero map proves subfamily monotonicity. Exact joint masses are proved using the actual joint affine system, its total effective row space, normalized uniform counting, rank-nullity and infinite-cylinder transport; the algebraic majorant has no undischarged model premise. Regrouping gives an explicit linear equivalence of relation kernels, proving nullity additivity. A general finite spectral partition identity yields exact joint and centered moment factorization, transported through actual finite/infinite cylinders with heterogeneous marginals. The final finite-set theorem reindexes the original family by its subtype, constructs its adequate cutoff internally, and includes the empty family. All effective relations are used, rather than only primitive block supports. See docs/DIRECT_COMPONENT_ALIGNMENT.md. No unproved literature, arithmetic or independent-block premise is used.

The actual subspace has the original codimension cost 2*card(V)*t^(-1/d), no nonzero dual form has t disjoint nonempty recoveries of sizes at most d, and coordinate multiplicity is at most t-1. Representations are unordered label supports, matching the source proof. Their cardinality is at most j!*(t-1)^(j-1), hence the original j!*t^(j-1). Disjoint label supports are lifted injectively to actual physical coordinate supports before applying recovery exclusion. The complete theorem holds over any field for any finite family of linear forms on a finite-dimensional space, with no separating or binary assumption.
